reason: Both conversations asked the right first question, got the hot-plastic description, and told her to stop using the fridge and unplug it, but neither mentioned the Beko recall or asked for the model and serial number. It also said clearly that the internal electrics must be left to the engineer. Conversation 2 gave a similar instruction and added a warning not to open the back panel, but it missed the buzzing and gave a slightly less complete picture, so it is marginally weaker.
